Referral Program FAQs
How much do I receive for a referral?

Eligible Better Remodels customers can receive $500 off a qualifying full-home remodeling project when their referral meets the program requirements.

How much does my referral receive?

Your referred customer receives $500 off their qualifying full-home remodeling project.

Does the $500 discount apply to any remodeling project?

The referral offer is specifically for qualifying full-home remodeling services. It does not automatically apply to individual rooms, repairs, maintenance, or other services unless Better Remodels specifically confirms otherwise.

When does my referral qualify?

A referral qualifies when the referred customer enters into a qualifying full-home remodeling agreement with Better Remodels and satisfies the applicable program requirements.

Is there a limit to how many people I can refer?

You may refer multiple people, but each referral must independently satisfy the program requirements.

Answer a few quick questions to receive a personalized price range for your specific project — no obligation required.

Take The Quiz Now
What to expect

Investing in kitchen remodeling or a bathroom renovation is a significant decision that impacts your home’s value and your daily quality of life. With hundreds of material options and varying labor standards, finding a clear starting point is difficult. That is why we developed the Better Remodels Instant Quote Quiz — allowing our experienced team to analyze your needs and provide a realistic breakdown.

THE COST MATRIX
What Factors Impact Your Estimate?

When searching for remodeling contractors, it’s important to understand that every quote is influenced by specific variables. Our quiz accounts for:

Square Footage

The total footprint of the kitchen or bathroom directly influences material quantities and labor hours. OC Average: Kitchens 120–200 sq ft · Bathrooms 50–100 sq ft

Structural Changes

Whether you are moving walls or plumbing stacks significantly impacts the engineering and permit requirements.

Material Grade

From custom cabinetry and quartz countertops to luxury vinyl or tile — your selections define the investment level.

Scope of Work

Simple cosmetic updates versus a full “studs-out” renovation produce dramatically different budgets.

You might not have every detail finalized yet — most homeowners don’t! Answer to the best of your ability.
